other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage through joint feature encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test sets to compute frequency encodings for categorical variables. This leaks the distribution of categories from the test set into the training features, compromising the strict separation of train and test data.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid solution using CatBoost with 5-fold stratified cross-validation and reasonable feature engineering. However, it introduces data leakage by computing categorical frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, the agent uses a simple unweighted average to ensemble fold predictions and only evaluates the model using a single metric (log loss).
